rubric.why: Morphology concerns the form and structure of organisms.
rubric.how: Award for identifying the study of an organism’s form and structure.

rubric.why: Histology is the study of tissues, including their structure.
rubric.how: Award for identifying the study of tissues or their structure.

modelAnswer: Morphology is the study of the form and structure of organisms.
Histology is the study of the structure of tissues.

rubric.why: Biophysics applies physics to biological phenomena.
rubric.how: Award for linking physics or its principles with biological phenomena.

rubric.why: Biometry applies mathematical or statistical methods to biological data or processes.
rubric.how: Award for linking measurement, mathematics or statistics with biology.

modelAnswer: Biophysics is the application of the principles and techniques of physics to biological phenomena.
Biometry is the application of mathematics and statistics to biological data or processes.

rubric.why: Immunology is the biological study of immunity.
rubric.description: Identifies immunology as a field of study.
rubric.how: Award for stating that immunology is the study of immunity or the immune system.

rubric.why: Immunity concerns the body's protection against disease-causing agents.
rubric.how: Award for mentioning the body's defence or protection against disease or pathogens.

modelAnswer: Immunology is the branch of biology that studies immunity and the immune system.
It deals with the body's defence against disease-causing organisms.

items.followUp: Why is a control group used in an experiment?

rubric.why: The control group does not receive the experimental treatment or variable.
rubric.how: Award for saying that it is kept untreated or under normal conditions.

rubric.why: The experimental group receives the treatment or variable being tested.
rubric.how: Award for stating that it is exposed to the tested variable or treatment.

modelAnswer: The control group is kept under normal conditions and does not receive the experimental treatment.
The experimental group is exposed to the variable or treatment being tested.

items.followUp: Which mosquito transmits malaria, and what is its role?

rubric.why: Ronald Ross investigated the cause and transmission of malaria.
rubric.description: Identifies his work as relating to malaria.
rubric.how: Award for naming malaria or its parasite as the subject of his work.

rubric.why: Ross showed that malaria is transmitted by the female Anopheles mosquito.
rubric.how: Award for identifying the mosquito as the route of malaria transmission; female Anopheles is the precise answer.

modelAnswer: Ronald Ross worked on malaria and its transmission.
He discovered that malaria is transmitted by the female Anopheles mosquito.

items.followUp: Name one plant tissue that provides mechanical support and state how it does so.

rubric.why: Sclerenchyma is the plant tissue with lignified, hardened cell walls.
Lignin thickens and hardens the cell walls.
rubric.how: Award for stating that lignin is deposited in the cell walls and makes them hard.

modelAnswer: Sclerenchyma is the plant tissue whose cell walls are hardened by lignin.
Its thick, lignified walls provide strength and support.

items.followUp: What is the main function of a bacterial cell wall?

rubric.why: A nucleoid is found in prokaryotic cells such as bacteria.
rubric.description: Locates the nucleoid in a prokaryotic cell.
rubric.how: Award for identifying it as a region of a prokaryotic or bacterial cell.

rubric.why: The nucleoid contains DNA but is not enclosed by a nuclear membrane.
rubric.how: Award for stating that it contains DNA and lacks a surrounding nuclear membrane.

modelAnswer: A nucleoid is the region in a prokaryotic cell that contains its DNA.
It is not surrounded by a nuclear membrane.

rubric.why: The Houbara Bustard is a migratory bird.
rubric.how: Award for describing it as a bird and identifying its migratory nature.

rubric.why: The Houbara Bustard visits Pakistan in winter and is threatened by hunting.
rubric.description: Gives a fact about its migration or conservation.
rubric.how: Award for stating that it visits Pakistan in winter, comes from Central Asia, or is threatened by hunting.

modelAnswer: The Houbara Bustard is a migratory bird that visits Pakistan in winter, arriving from Central Asia.
